title: Co-authored one CI/CD reference architecture for the company
summary: I co-authored the company CI/CD reference architecture whitepaper and its reference pipelines, and worked the architecture community's review comments into later versions so businesses had one baseline to adopt.
what_would_have_happened: Each business would have designed its own pipeline from scratch.
the_call: Write one reference architecture teams can adopt, and settle objections in the document itself.
what_i_did: Wrote sections and review notes, and addressed comments from the strategic architecture community in later versions.
what_changed: The whitepaper and reference pipelines became the shared baseline; a co-author thanked me for the review notes.

quotes.text: Thanks to Datta's notes as well; it was interesting to work on these comments.
